page.overview:
Who is Bikouros?

Bikouros was one of the Fremen Naibs accused by Bijaz as a traitor against the Atreides Empire.

In a deleted scene from Dune Messiah, Bikouros flees with Cahueit and Djedida into the desert upon realising their betrayal will be revealed, ostensibly bringing Djedida as a Qizarate observer.
